create_get_logger: create a multiprocessing-aware logger with get_logger using a module name and optional log level
log_main_process_only: log a message only on the main process using MultiProcessAdapter.log with main_process_only=True
log_all_processes: log a message across all processes using MultiProcessAdapter.log with main_process_only=False
log_in_order: log messages in order across all processes using MultiProcessAdapter.log with in_order=True
warn_once: emit a warning message only once across multiple calls using MultiProcessAdapter.warning_once
